description: We are team GAÏNDE-IA, developing a solution for the NASA Space Apps Challenge—a smart platform for real-time offshore oil leak detection. Using IoT sensors and AI (logistic regression/sigmoid model), our solution turns raw data into proactive alerts to protect marine ecosystems.
summary: GAINDE-IA is an intelligent web platform designed for the proactive detection and real-time monitoring of offshore oil and gas leaks. Inspired by critical incidents such as the February 2025 gas leak at Senegal's Grand Tortue Ahmeyim (GTA) field, our solution shifts offshore safety from a reactive approach to a predictive one. By combining specialized IoT sensors (measuring hydrocarbon concentration, pressure, temperature, and turbidity) with a logistic regression (sigmoid) AI algorithm, GAINDE-IA detects anomalies early, assesses leak probabilities, and delivers instant color-coded alerts to both oil operators and regulatory authorities to protect marine ecosystems and human lives.
details:
GAINDE-IA (Automated Management of Environmental Information and Data by AI) monitors offshore oil and gas infrastructures through two main operational modes and role-based access control (for regulatory bodies like Senegal's Ministry of Energy, Petroleum and Mines, and for oil operators like BP or Woodside):

- Real-Time Monitoring Mode: Simulates a continuous live data stream from specialized IoT sensors strategically placed on critical offshore zones: hydrocarbon concentration (ppm) at wellheads and manifolds, pressure (bar) along subsea pipelines, temperature (°C) on processing equipment, and turbidity (NTU) near safety valves and pumps

- Spot Detection Mode: Analyzes historical sensor data batches to perform automated safety audits and identify past anomalies.

- AI Risk Assessment (Sigmoid Function): Rather than relying on rigid binary thresholds that cause false alarms, our AI model uses a logistic (sigmoid) function calibrated around international offshore standards (e.g., API RP 1130, API RP 70, API 580). It translates continuous multi-sensor variations into a nuanced leak probability (0% to 100%) alongside a regulatory status (Normal, Moderate, Critical).
projectRefs: API RP 1130 - Computational Pipeline Monitoring for Liquids
